title: MX Sentinel Event Envelope
description: Common wrapper for every message published to the event bus. The payload is type-specific and validated against the schema matching `event_type`. See docs/event-contracts.md.

schema_version.description: Semver of the payload schema for this event_type.

event_id.description: Globally unique event id (UUIDv7, time-sortable). Consumers dedupe on this.

event_type.description: Dotted event type, e.g. smtp.delivered, dns.changed.

occurred_at.description: When the real-world event happened (relay timestamp, DNS poll time).

source.description: Emitting component and node, e.g. telemetryd@relay-03.

payload.description: Type-specific body; validate against the schema for event_type.

correlation.description: Correlation keys lifted out of the payload so the correlation engine can join events without parsing payloads. All fields optional; presence depends on event type.
